mapper.select: select r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from sys_role r inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.del_flag = 0 order by r.role_sort, r.role_id
